title: Web workspace scripts depend on tools the workspace does not declare
reasoning: The web package exposes workspace-local test, lint, and deploy scripts, and its tests/config require jsdom plus Testing Library. The deploy script invokes wrangler. Those packages and bins are not declared in apps/web/package.json, so the scripts currently rely on root or sibling workspace dependencies being installed. That works in a full monorepo install, but focused workspace installs, package-graph CI, or removing the sibling/root declarations can break web test/lint/deploy with missing module or missing binary errors.
reproduction: In a dependency check scoped to @uiuc-course-search/web, @testing-library/react, @testing-library/jest-dom, jsdom, eslint, and wrangler are not direct dependencies of the web workspace even though its scripts/tests use them.
recommendation: Declare the web-owned test/lint/deploy tools in apps/web devDependencies, or move the corresponding scripts to the root package and make the root package explicitly own those dependencies.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included tests exercise behavior after the full repository dependency tree is already installed; they do not validate the web workspace's package dependency closure or run scripts from a focused web-only install.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a CI/package metadata check such as npm ls -w @uiuc-course-search/web @testing-library/react @testing-library/jest-dom jsdom eslint wrangler --depth=0, or run the web scripts from a focused workspace install.
minimumFixScope: Update apps/web/package.json devDependencies and the lockfile, unless the scripts are intentionally moved to the root package metadata.
